data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement check-prereqs + invoke-platform-cli phases: detect Docker (pre-flight error if absent, link to Docker Desktop install page; not auto-installed); detect uv on macOS (Homebrew if present, else `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`) and Linux (official curl installer); after uv installer, unconditionally export PATH; verify nava-platform; fail fast if not found. `--auto-install-prereqs` skips interactive confirmation; without flag AND prompt required AND no TTY → abort with `[A1] phase=check-prereqs no TTY for prereq prompt; pass --auto-install-prereqs for unattended`. Linux package manager selection per OS detection. Windows users redirected to WSL2 with clear error.
**Why**: One-command Strata Rails+SDK+USWDS scaffold for non-technical users requires prerequisites to install reliably and unattended.
**Scope**:
- IN: OS matrix macOS + Linux; Homebrew/curl uv install paths; PATH export; nava-platform pinned to v1.0.0 of template-application-rails; `nava-platform app install --template-uri ... --version v1.0.0 --data app_name=app --data app_local_port=<port> . app` invocation; project-root layout (my-prototype/, my-prototype/app/); failure semantics (abort, not warn-and-continue); TTY check for non-interactive abort.
- OUT: copier.yml diff guard (separate story); overlay (separate story); SDK gem-add (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, on macOS without uv, --auto-install-prereqs installs uv via Homebrew when present, else curl ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, on Linux without uv, the official curl installer runs and PATH is exported ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, Docker absent emits the pre-flight error and aborts ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, no-TTY without --auto-install-prereqs aborts with the named error ← Satisfies: SC1, SC3
- When complete, nava-platform pin (v1.0.0) is verified post-install ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, project layout is my-prototype/ root with my-prototype/app/ as Rails app ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for OS detection, install-paths, TTY semantics

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Failure is abort, not warn-and-continue
- [Reliability] PATH export unconditional after uv installer
- [Maintainability] Document Windows -> WSL2 redirect

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a non-technical user, prereqs (uv, nava-platform) auto-install on macOS+Linux with TTY-safe semantics
